findings.detail: The charter never states the implementation BASE, and the branch it was handed (parent cffcdb9 = main tip) does not contain ORI-RN-004's deliverable commit 001488c, so every proof it mandates is unrunnable. Absent from this base but delivered by 001488c: tests/sprint-05-orient-search/support/live-example-proof.test.ts (the 886-line driver named in every VERIFY command and in WRITE-ALLOWED as MODIFY), apps/example/app/live-chat.tsx, apps/example/components/live-chat-screen.tsx, apps/example/components/live-chat-message.tsx, tests/sprint-05-orient-search/live-example.maestro.yaml, and the ORI-RN-004 revision of apps/example/tsconfig.live-chat.json (whose base version includes only lib/*.ts, so the scoped tsc gate would compile a stale narrower program and report a false green). FIX: add an explicit base statement to the charter and DEPENDENCIES - implement on a branch based on kb-run-sprint/sprint-05-orient-search/ORI-RN-004 @ 001488c (or merge it in first), listing the artifacts it supplies.

Defect B's fix location is allowlisted only for app.json (if the compiler is confirmed) or use-live-chat.ts initialization. If the bisect implicates an ORI-RN-004-owned file, the minimal fix would fall outside WRITE-ALLOWED. FIX: add an escalation rule - if the bisect points outside the two allowlisted locations, stop and report for a scope amendment rather than expanding the diff.

AC-1's DONE WHEN could be over-read as covering the cross-origin path; the driver is same-origin by construction so it cannot detect a missing-CORS regression. Already disclosed in OPEN QUESTIONS. FIX (optional): repeat the one-clause qualifier in DONE WHEN.

summary: Defect A is correctly diagnosed and located (verified against the installed babel-preset-expo@57.0.10 plugin source); Defect B is honestly scoped as a hypothesis with a mandated bisect, and is more careful than ORI-RN-004's own RED.md; the allowlist has no missed live assertion; the proofs are genuinely real; the hook bypass is defensible. One blocking defect: the charter never states its implementation base and the branch lacks ORI-RN-004's 001488c, so the driver/route/components/maestro/tsconfig are absent and all four proofs are unrunnable. A short base statement closes it.
